claim_debunked: Government declared an emergency bank holiday in 4 districts and banks are facing liquidity failure.
text: PIB Fact Check and the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) confirmed that viral notices claiming an emergency bank holiday has been declared across four districts due to liquidity shortage are completely FAKE and DEBUNKED. All public and private sector banks are operating normally on standard clearing schedules. No emergency banking restrictions have been ordered.
publisher: PIB Fact Check / Reserve Bank of India

topic: RBI Discontinuation of 500 Rupee Currency Notes
claim_debunked: RBI is discontinuing 500 rupee banknotes from circulation starting next month.
text: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) refuted viral social media claims alleging that 500 rupee denomination notes are being discontinued or demonetized. RBI issued an official advisory stating that no such notification was issued, and 500 rupee notes remain sovereign legal tender.
publisher: Reserve Bank of India Press Office

claim_debunked: Government to levy mandatory 3% transaction surcharge on all UPI transactions.
text: National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) and Ministry of Finance officially clarified that person-to-person (P2P) and person-to-merchant (P2M) UPI payments remain completely free for consumers. Claims of a mandatory 3% surcharge on standard bank-to-bank UPI transfers are fabricated and false.

topic: Patna Curfew and Police Firing Rumor
claim_debunked: Police opened fire on student protesters in Patna and statewide curfew has been imposed.
text: Bihar Police Headquarters and District Magistrate Patna issued an urgent rebuttal refuting viral WhatsApp and X rumors asserting that police opened fire on student agitators and curfew was declared. Police confirmed zero casualties, no firing incidents occurred, and no curfew has been declared. Legal action under Section 353 BNS has been initiated against rumor-mongers.
publisher: Bihar State Police Headquarters / Cyber STF

claim_debunked: Statewide Section 144 imposed with complete shutdown of public transport.
text: Home Department of Bihar clarified that orders under Section 144 CrPC / 163 BNSS are localized to specific sensitive government premises and no blanket statewide curfew or complete transport shutdown was ever promulgated. Public transport and inter-district buses are functioning without disruption.

topic: Internet Blackout in North Bihar Districts
claim_debunked: Internet and mobile SMS services suspended across North Bihar for 72 hours.
text: Department of Telecommunications and Bihar Cyber Crime Coordination Center (B4C) declared that messages claiming a 72-hour statewide internet suspension are baseless hoaxes. No internet suspension orders under Telecom Suspension Rules have been sanctioned.

topic: BPSC Preliminary Examination Paper Leak Rumor
claim_debunked: BPSC Teacher / Administrative Services question paper leaked on Telegram channels 2 hours prior to exam.
text: Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) issued an official press release stating that alleged question papers circulating on Telegram and social media were forensic fabrications containing mixed questions from previous mock tests. Sealed question paper integrity was verified across all exam centers; the examination was conducted successfully without breach.

topic: Railway Recruitment Board Exam Cancellation Notice
claim_debunked: Railway Recruitment Board cancelled all technical non-popular NTPC posts across Eastern Zone.
text: Ministry of Railways officially confirmed that viral PDF circulars announcing the sudden cancellation of NTPC recruitment vacancies are fraudulent and photoshopped. Official recruitment notifications are published solely on rrbcdg.gov.in and exams remain scheduled as planned.
publisher: Ministry of Railways / Press Information Bureau

topic: PM Free Solar Panel Yojana 5000 Rupees Subsidy Portal
claim_debunked: Government offering free solar panel and cash transfer of 5000 rupees via viral registration link.
text: PIB Fact Check warned citizens that links circulating on social media offering free solar equipment and immediate 5,000 rupee bank subsidies upon clicking an external APK/link are phishing and cyber fraud vectors. The PM Surya Ghar scheme operates exclusively via official domain pmsuryaghar.gov.in and requires no third-party registration fees.

topic: Kanya Sumangala Scheme 2 Lakh Rupee Cash Grant Link
claim_debunked: Direct cash grant of 2,00,000 rupees being deposited in accounts of girl students who share WhatsApp link.
text: PIB Fact Check confirmed that viral messages promising two lakh rupees direct benefit transfer to girl students upon forwarding a message are cyber fraud traps designed to harvest personal information. No such unconditional grant program exists.

topic: EVM Wireless Connectivity and Remote Tampering
claim_debunked: Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs) connected to Wi-Fi and Bluetooth during counting.
text: Election Commission of India (ECI) repeatedly demonstrated and judicially established in the Supreme Court of India that Indian EVMs and VVPAT units are completely standalone micro-controller devices with no wireless, Bluetooth, or internet transmission hardware. Claims alleging remote hacking via signals are scientifically impossible and refuted.

topic: Deletion of 50 Lakh Names from State Voter Roll
claim_debunked: Election Commission secretly deleted 50 lakh voters belonging to minority communities.
text: Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) clarified that summary revision of electoral rolls follows strict statutory public notice procedures with multi-party booth level agents. Claims of mass covert deletions of 50 lakh electors without due process were proven unsubstantiated and refuted.
publisher: Chief Electoral Officer / Election Commission of India

claim_debunked: All express and local trains suspended across Northern Railway zone due to staff walkout.
text: Ministry of Railways and Northern Railway press office issued an official clarification debunking reports of a nationwide rail stoppage. Train operations on all mail, express, and freight routes are running on normal timetables.

topic: Synthetic Audio of Political Leaders Leaked Tape
claim_debunked: Authentic leaked audio recording reveals leaders conspiring to rig elections.
text: State Forensic Science Laboratory (SFSL) acoustic analysis confirmed that viral voice clips circulating on social media attributing incriminating admissions to political leadership were synthetic voice clones generated via deep neural speech synthesis, containing spectral phase discontinuities and lacking acoustic ambient room impulse response.

claim_debunked: Factual history regarding the enactment of the three agricultural bills.
text: The Parliament of India passed three agricultural reform bills in September 2020: the Farmers' Produce Trade and Commerce Act, the Farmers Agreement on Price Assurance Act, and the Essential Commodities Amendment Act.

claim_debunked: Status of the farm laws repeal.
text: Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced the repeal of the three farm laws on November 19, 2021, and Parliament formally passed the Farm Laws Repeal Bill on November 29, 2021.

claim_debunked: Whether minimum support price has a statutory constitutional guarantee in India.
text: While minimum support price (MSP) is announced administratively for 23 mandated crops, there is no existing statutory or constitutional legal guarantee compelling private buyers to purchase at MSP.
publisher: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, India

claim_debunked: Number of police FIRs registered during the tractor rally incident.
text: Delhi Police officially registered over 25 first information reports (FIRs) against farm union leaders and demonstrators following incidents of vandalism and unauthorized deviations during the Republic Day tractor rally on January 26, 2021.

claim_debunked: Whether FISA authorization existed regarding Manafort.
text: US investigators obtained a FISA court wiretap authorization monitoring Paul Manafort during the 2016 campaign in connection with undisclosed foreign lobbying and financial transactions with pro-Russian Ukrainian politicians.
publisher: US Department of Justice / Mueller Report

claim_debunked: Allegation that President Obama ordered surveillance of Trump Tower.
text: FBI Director James Comey and the Department of Justice officially testified that there was no evidence to support allegations that President Obama ordered surveillance or wiretapping of Trump Tower.

claim_debunked: Outcome of Senator Bob Menendez federal trial.
text: Democratic Senator Bob Menendez was on federal trial in Newark in autumn 2017 facing bribery and corruption charges involving a Florida eye doctor; the trial concluded in a mistrial in November 2017 due to a hung jury.
publisher: US Attorney's Office, District of New Jersey
